label: LLM Params
description: Completion parameters for LLM nodes (system prompt, sampling knobs, reasoning). Provider-agnostic: the same params drive any wired provider. When multiple LLM nodes share the same settings, point them at one LlmParams node; only use multiple when you truly need different settings.

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.label: System Prompt
inputs.description: System prompt for every LLM node wired to these params. Seeds the conversation as its first (role: system) message and rides the history from then on; a history already opening with a system message keeps it, so to switch instructions mid-chain append a system message with the Chat Message node.

inputs.name: maxTokens
inputs.label: Max Tokens
inputs.description: The most tokens the reply may hold, thinking included on a reasoning model. Unset, nothing is sent and the provider's own default applies.

inputs.name: stop
inputs.label: Stop sequences
inputs.description: Generation stops when the model produces any of these strings.

inputs.name: reasoning
inputs.label: Enable Reasoning
inputs.description: Off by default: the call sends no reasoning request. A model that cannot switch reasoning off refuses on providers that spell the off position, and the error says to set this on; on the others it reasons at its own default and bills the thinking. A model with no reasoning fails with its provider's own error: set this off. On: reasoning at `reasoningEffort` (`low` when none is picked, raise it for one hard step). A reasoning model that answered nothing usually spent `maxTokens` thinking: raise it.

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning Effort
inputs.description: Only used when reasoning is enabled. Unpicked means `low`.

inputs.name: forcePrepend
inputs.label: Force response prefix
inputs.description: Force the model's reply to start with this exact text (constrained generation).

outputs.name: params
outputs.description: The parameters object, fed into one or more LLM nodes.
